Description: Log in inline in THIS context. Paired with reuseAuthState:false so there is one browser and one window - login then straight into the test. login.csv steps 70/80 poll for the landing page so this also covers the app cold-start
Wait for the projects page to finish loading (app cold-starts ~26s; networkidle never settles because Application Insights beacons continuously)
Wait for the loading overlay to clear before clicking New Project (visible does not mean hydrated)
Confirm the new project dialog actually opened before filling it (mirrors login.csv step 100)
Open the Start Date picker (date must be picked; the textbox cannot be filled)
Pick the Start Date day cell. NOTE: hardcoded to Jul 15 2026 and only matches while the picker opens on that month; not driven by ${data.project.Start Date}
Select Phase (custom dropdown; select opens the menu then commits the option)
Select the Test (custom dropdown). Replaces the old fill of SelectTask plus the separate testId click - step 250 already picked the Design task and select commits the option itself
Select Test Type. #testtype is a NATIVE select so it needs select (not fill); select matches by visible label first
Select Test Statistic. #testStatistic is a NATIVE select so it needs select (not fill)
fill Coefficient of Variation of Data
Confirm Compute in the credit-alert dialog. Screenshot on failure - this dialog is the least understood part of the flow
Confirm the app landed on the results list grid after Compute. Split out from 465 so a stall here is distinguishable from a status that never flips
Poll the run status until it reaches Completed before opening the result. Throws on Failed and raises SIMULATION_TIMEOUT. Status flips in ~20s so 120s is a fail-fast ceiling not a wait
Open the computed result by name. Generous timeout - the link only appears once the compute finishes
Capture EVERY table on the result detail page into one tidy row-set. Table count varies per feature so it is discovered not assumed. Sets lastActualRows for compareWithBaseline

Compare the captured cells against the benchmark in 06_baseline/<env>/. First run has no baseline so it writes one and reports BASELINE_CREATED (green - nothing verified yet); every run after that is a real PASS/FAIL
